Metadata.title: GetFit
Metadata.description: A structured programme that combines strength training and running, with recovery built in.

Landing.title: GetFit
Landing.tagline: Strength training and running, together in one structured programme.
Landing.subtitle: Every day, know what to do, why it matters and when to recover.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: If {email} can be used, we have sent a confirmation link to it. Open it to activate your account.
checkInbox.hint: The link works on any device. Check your spam folder if nothing arrives within a few minutes.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first, using the link we sent you.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.invalidLink: This link has expired or was already used. Log in, or sign up again to get a new one.
errors.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
resetPassword.sentBody: If an account uses {email}, we have sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works on any device.

updatePassword.title: Choose a new password
updatePassword.intro: You will stay signed in on this device. Your other devices will be signed out.
updatePassword.doneBody: Use your new password the next time you log in. Your other devices have been signed out.

error.title: Your profile could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection, then try again.

preferences.intro: The language applies to your account on every device. The theme applies to this device only.

States.errorBody: We couldn’t load this page. Check your connection and try again.

Start.title: Start your programme
Start.intro: Choose when week 1 begins. Nothing is scheduled before that day.
Start.options: When do you want to start?
Start.nextMondayHint: Week 1 begins next Monday, with a full week ahead.
Start.thisWeekHint: Week 1 began on Monday. Days already past are not scheduled and do not count.
Start.error: The programme could not be started. Please try again.

equipmentWarning.title: Equipment to check
equipmentWarning.body: This programme uses: {items}. You didn't select it. You can still start; check that you have it before the sessions that need it.

availabilityNote.title: Your days differ from the programme's
availabilityNote.body: Your answers for {days} differ from the programme. The programme keeps its own days; you can move a session within its week when needed.

Onboarding.error: Your answers could not be saved. Please try again.

profile.title: About you
profile.intro: Only your first name is required. You can change everything later in your profile.
profile.timezoneHint: Your days start and end in this time zone. It was detected from your browser.
profile.timezoneSettingsHint: Your days start and end in this time zone. Changing it never moves a session you have logged.

goals.title: Your goals
goals.intro: Choose as many as you like.

experience.title: Your experience
experience.intro: This helps us suggest the right programme.

hints.beginner: New to structured training, or coming back after a long break

equipment.title: Your equipment
equipment.intro: Choose everything you can train with.

availability.title: Your week
availability.intro: Pre-filled with the programme's days. Your answers don't move any session.

baselines.title: Your starting point
baselines.intro: All optional. These are your baselines: the reference your progress is compared with. They are never shown as workouts.
baselines.testsHint: Strict, with good form, in one set.
baselines.runHint: Leave empty if you don't have one.

confirm.paceTooFast: A pace of {pace} /{unit} is unusually fast. Check the distance and the time, or save anyway.
confirm.paceTooSlow: A pace of {pace} /{unit} is unusually slow. Check the distance and the time, or save anyway.

errors.timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.oneRunningDay: Choose one run day at most.
errors.count: Enter a whole number between 0 and 500.
errors.runIncomplete: Enter both a distance and a time, or leave both empty.

beforeStart.title: Your programme starts on {date}
beforeStart.body: Week 1 begins with {session}. Nothing is scheduled until then.

finished.title: You have reached the end of the programme
finished.body: All {weeks} weeks are behind you. Your logged sessions stay in your history.

action.error: The workout could not be opened. Please try again.

thisWeek.adherenceUnavailable: No training session is planned this week.

recent.title: Recent activity
recent.emptyBody: Your workouts and runs will appear here once you log them.

attention.title: {day} was missed
attention.body: {session} can still be moved to another day this week, or skipped.

Programme.title: Programme
Programme.intro: Eight weeks, each with its focus. Open a week to see its days and targets.
Programme.pastDay: This day is past. Only what you logged is shown.

error.title: The programme could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection, then try again.

Programme.savedDay: This session is saved. Open the workout to see what you logged.

actions.title: Change this session
actions.refused: This change isn’t possible any more: the week has changed. The page now shows it as it is.
actions.error: The change could not be saved. Please try again.

reschedule.title: Move this session
reschedule.description: Pick a day in this week. Days that break a recovery rule can’t be chosen.
reschedule.noDate: No day this week fits the recovery rules. Skipping keeps the plan safe; never double up.

blocks.strength_day_before: {session} is the day before: no strength on consecutive days
blocks.strength_day_after: {session} is the day after: no strength on consecutive days
blocks.lower_body_before_run: Within 2 days before {session}: legs stay fresh for the long run
blocks.run_after_lower_body: {session} is within the 2 days before: legs stay fresh for the long run
blocks.day_taken: {session} is already on this day: one session per day

skip.title: Skip this session
skip.description: A skipped session isn’t counted as missed. You can undo it until its day.
skip.reasonHint: Only you see it. {count} of 200 characters.

Train.title: Train
Train.intro: Start today’s session, log a run, and find everything you have logged.
Train.restDay: A rest day: nothing to start today.
Train.notEnrolled: Start your programme to see today’s session here.
Train.logRunHint: Any run, on any day. It can count for the long run of its week.

empty.title: Nothing logged yet
empty.body: Your workouts and runs will be listed here once you log them.

error.title: Your training could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection, then try again.

pause.title: Workout paused

skip.skipped: Skipped. Its sets stay unlogged, so this workout can only be saved as partial.

substitute.title: Substitute {name}

NotFound.title: Page not found

confirm.paceTooSlow: A pace of {pace} /{unit} is unusually slow. Check the distance and the time, or save anyway.

errors.futureStart: This start is in the future. Check the date and time.
errors.linkUnavailable: Your week changed. Answer again whether this run counts.
